{"id": "58e8816b-b893-4fd0-b485-9acb31af0dc5", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "A common cause of this is that \"valid JSON\" and \"valid per record\" aren't the same thing for batch transform. If `SplitType` is `Line`, each line is sent to the model as its own record. A pretty-printed JSON file or a single top-level JSON array then breaks at the line boundaries. Other possible causes are a `ContentType` or `AcceptType` that doesn't match what the container expects, a trailing blank line, a BOM or odd encoding in some rows, or a record larger than `MaxPayloadInMB`.
